clinical.citation: Anonymous et al. 2022 - de novo variant calling identifies cancer mutation signatures in the 1000 Genomes Project (PMID: 36054329)

variants.description: Excess of protein-coding de novo variants in IGLL5 in 1000 Genomes LCL-derived WGS data; specific variants not given in abstract; likely cell line (somatic hypermutation) artifacts

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Statistically significant excess of protein-coding DNVs in IGLL5, a gene involved in B-cell lymphomas; interpreted as likely LCL cell-line artifacts rather than pathogenic germline variants

clinical.citation: A discovery resource of rare copy number variations in individuals with autism spectrum disorder (PMID: 23275889)

variants.description: 22q11.23 gain (~656 kb), maternally inherited, encompassing RAB36, FBXW4P1, RTDR1, GNAZ, MIR650, IGLL5, BCR (heterozygous copy gain)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Rare inherited CNV in an ASD case detected by CGH array; IGLL5 only one of several genes in the interval, not specifically implicated as causal

biological.citation: IGLL5 controlled by super-enhancer affects cell survival and MYC expression in mature B-cell lymphoma (PMID: 38444524)
biological.summary: Two mature B-cell lymphoma cell lines expressed IGLL5 mRNA containing the Cλ1 segment. JQ1 (BET inhibitor) treatment down-regulated IGLL5, indicating super-enhancer control. IGLL5 knockdown induced cell death with reduced MYC expression, suggesting a role in survival and MYC regulation.

biological.citation: A multiple myeloma-specific capture sequencing platform discovers novel translocations and frequent, risk-associated point mutations in IGLL5 (PMID: 29563506)
biological.summary: IGLL5 was recurrently mutated in 18% of multiple myeloma tumors. The mutations were mutually exclusive with RAS mutations and associated with increased risk of disease progression. Novel IGLL5/IGH translocations were found in two samples.

biological.citation: Identification of hub genes and therapeutic drugs in rheumatoid arthritis patients (PMID: 33604823)
biological.summary: IGLL5 was identified as an upregulated hub gene in RA synovial expression datasets, in the context of enrichment for B cell receptor signalling and immune response. qRT-PCR confirmed its overexpression in RA patient blood versus healthy controls. hsa-miR-1185-5p and hsa-miR-3679-5p were predicted to regulate it.
biological.sample_size: GEO datasets GSE55235 and GSE12021 plus RA patient and healthy control blood samples

biological.citation: Gene expression profiling of periodontitis-affected gingival tissue by spatial transcriptomics (PMID: 29921943)
biological.summary: IGLL5 was the most up-regulated gene in inflamed versus non-inflamed gingival connective tissue, together with SSR4, MZB1 and XBP1. RT-qPCR confirmed higher expression in periodontitis patients than in healthy controls, and protein expression was supported by immunohistochemistry.
biological.significance: significantly up-regulated (specific p-values not given in abstract)

biological.citation: IGLL5 is correlated with tumor-infiltrating immune cells in clear cell renal cell carcinoma (PMID: 33449444)
biological.summary: In TCGA ccRCC, IGLL5 was the single gene overlapping between the PPI network and Cox regression analyses. Its expression correlated positively with three types of tumor-infiltrating immune cells and may be a prognostic biomarker.

biological.citation: Lineage-negative lymphoma with a helper innate lymphoid cell phenotype (PMID: 31522287)
biological.summary: Next-generation sequencing of an aggressive lineage-negative lymphoma with a helper ILC phenotype identified a novel IGLV2-14/IGLL5 fusion. This adds IGLL5 to the list of genes involved in rearrangements in hematologic malignancy.

biological.citation: Lymphoma driver mutations at the root of somatic evolution of nerve-damaging autoantibodies in myelin associated glycoprotein neuropathy (PMID: 40915157)
biological.summary: Single-cell DNA and RNA analysis of MAG-autoantibody B cell clones found sub-clonal branches with somatic mutations in IGLL5, along with CXCR4 and BTG2, acquired after MYD88 L265P. This implicates IGLL5 mutation in the clonal evolution of autoreactive B cells.

biological.citation: Comprehensive characterization of driver genes in diffuse large B cell lymphoma (PMID: 32565964)
biological.summary: Computational driver-gene analysis identified IGLL5 as the most frequently mutated gene in DLBCL, ahead of MLL2, BTG2, B2M, PIM1 and CARD11.

biological.citation: Dynamic landscape of m6A modifications and related post-transcriptional events in muscle-invasive bladder cancer (PMID: 39380003)
biological.summary: Nanopore direct-RNA sequencing identified a novel m6A site in the IGLL5 3'UTR in MIBC tumors. The site showed a lower m6A methylation ratio, elongated poly(A) tails and biased transcript usage, suggesting post-transcriptional regulation of IGLL5.
biological.sample_size: 3 paired MIBC tumor/normal samples plus validation pairs

biological.citation: Molecular biomarkers screened by next-generation RNA sequencing for non-sentinel lymph node status prediction in breast cancer patients with metastatic sentinel lymph nodes (PMID: 26311227)
biological.summary: RNA-seq of sentinel lymph node metastases found that IGLL5 was the most frequently fused gene among 10 gene fusions in the NSLN-positive group.
